scope: Verified signed AS2 processing warnings, errors and failures through an explicit local receipt profile

red.observation: The original CLI refused the explicit signed outcome profile before reading the OpenSSL report.

green.environment: macOS ARM, Go 1.27.4, stock OpenSSL 4.0.3, protected files
assertions: The native command verifies signed processed, processed/warning, processed/error and failed reports using the same peer pin, original ID and recipient binding as the default profile.
A processed report requires a matching MIC. A warning, error or failure may omit it. An absent MIC has explicit status and the result omits the digest. All present MICs require the original digest.

Stock OpenSSL signed a complete processed/error capture without a MIC. The CLI reported decryption-failed, MIC absent, receiver durability unknown and business acceptance unknown. The default positive profile returned no verified output.

The race replay refused a false or missing MIC for positive processing, a false warning MIC, a different original message ID, contradictory report fields and unsupported dispositions. Free text stayed out of output.

remaining: Native Linux exact replay, durable storage of authenticated disposition evidence, live synchronous and asynchronous AS2 HTTP handling, encrypted messages, certificate rollover and independent stock AS2 application qualification.
